caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bucket, cylindrical in shape, composed of vertical wooden staves held together by two horizontal, dark brown or black metal bands, one near the top and one near the bottom. The bucket is colored in various shades of brown, suggesting a natural wood material, and is shown against a plain, light beige background. The bucket features two elongated, vertical handles opposite each other, each with a rounded top and a cutout heart shape near the upper part. The inside and outside of the bucket are visible, with lines indicating the construction from separate wooden planks. The artist's signature, “Ralph Russell,” is written in small letters in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Milk Tub
